name: excite
stdout:
excite:  monad  →hν→  monad*
  δ (light): promote to the excited manifold — Criticality ⊙ ⊙→𐑻 (the non-Hermitian exceptional-point resonance: metastable, finite lifetime — it DECAYS).
  monad*  ⟨𐑼𐑶𐑽𐑬𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑝𐑻𐑓𐑳𐑷⟩
  decay channels (the two Frobenius legs out of monad*):
    μ (relaxation / fluorescence): monad* → monad  — returns to the ground form, lossless (μ∘δ=id).
    productive: the elevated ⊙ drives chemistry the ground state cannot — monad* is a far stronger donor/acceptor (see `--set monad <acceptor> --excite`).
